badCaseAudit.failure: The resumed frozen-code run had four MODEL_TIMEOUT attempts at approximately 300 seconds; DSH pi-ai provider defaults streamIdleTimeoutMs to 300000ms and DshWebRuntime does not override it. This is the adapter's no-stream idle watchdog, not the 600s eval timeout.
badCaseAudit.quickFix: Set/observe the adapter idle timeout and preserve safe provider diagnostics, then run a new same-version A/B comparison; not changed in this sprint.

badCaseAudit.quickFix: Retain exception name, safe HTTP status, and SSE terminal reason; not changed in this sprint.

evidenceCitationMeasurement.stableIdSolution: RAG emits opaque content-bound MED-<16 hex> IDs; prompts request [evidence:<ID>]; evaluator exact-matches IDs against same-task RAG results.

medicalClaimSupportValidity.reason: Source ID resolution proves same-turn linkage, not whether a passage supports an adjacent medical claim; no independent claim-to-passage adjudication was performed.

resumeBullet: 在 GPT-6-Luna 驱动的本地合成工程试跑中，基于 DeepSeek Harness 打通患者就诊上下文、AMA 纵向记忆及带稳定来源 ID 的本地 RAG；在 2 例完整合成纵向病例、31 个同病例同轮配对任务中，Integrated 关键任务完成率为 64.5%（20/31），Single 为 41.9%（13/31），净增 22.6 个百分点；已披露病史事实正确引用率为 72.7%（16/22），医学来源 ID 精确匹配率为 50.0%（10/20），医学证据对结论的支持有效性尚不可测。
